programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot
governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
negative_findings: Inherited canonical flat-crosser exposes exact intercept/physical lead and must remain hidden oracle/reference truth only.
Current target engine does not certify realistic clay aerodynamics; virtual-shooter results must retain provisional world-model status.
Current centreline evaluator is a 110 mm disc sensitivity proxy only; it does not model target orientation, shot cloud or breakability.
Naive point-at-extrapolated-target baseline is intentionally weak and achieved 0/12 proxy hits; it is a lower baseline, not a human-performance claim.
Base L1 stable-crosser uncertainty was materially under-dispersed; held-out calibration requires large azimuth sigma scale factors of roughly 2.0–3.5 depending on observation condition.
Condition-specific global uncertainty scaling is an acceptable calibration gate but not the desired final belief architecture; a more principled heteroscedastic model should be tested later.
Perfect left/right direction accuracy on simple stable crossers is an easy-task result, not general target-reading proof.
Multi-family 300 ms reading is useful but crosser-v-quarterer remains materially harder than looper recognition.
Poor 220 ms acquisition collapses crosser-v-quarterer discrimination to 0.1833 accuracy; the model correctly lowers confidence but is not decision-ready in that condition.
Current looper family is a gravity-only engineering toy with an unusually strong vertical-curvature signature; 1.0 looper recall is not real-clay looper validation.
Multi-family probability calibration has not yet received a dedicated held-out reliability/ECE calibration gate.
No Brett Winstanley hold/pickup/break-point claim promoted without a recovered primary source.
next_action: Add held-out multi-family probability calibration and a selective WAIT_FOR_MORE_INFORMATION experiment on ambiguous 200-300 ms observations. Test whether waiting 50-150 ms materially improves unseen crosser/quarterer discrimination and path prediction without oracle access; close L1 only if confidence/reliability and selective waiting are credible.
